journeys: SELECT j.id,j.started_at AS startedAt,j.ended_at AS endedAt,j.miles,j.duration_minutes AS minutes,j.start_place_id AS startPlaceId,j.end_place_id AS endPlaceId FROM local_journeys j WHERE j.user_id=? AND julianday(j.started_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(j.ended_at)<=julianday(?) ORDER BY j.started_at DESC,j.id LIMIT 20001
music: SELECT m.id,m.journey_id AS journeyId,m.played_at AS playedAt,m.track,m.artist,COALESCE(m.album,'') AS album FROM local_music_entries m JOIN local_journeys j ON j.id=m.journey_id AND j.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.user_id=? AND julianday(j.started_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(j.ended_at)<=julianday(?) AND julianday(m.played_at)>=julianday(j.started_at) AND julianday(m.played_at)<=julianday(j.ended_at) ORDER BY m.played_at DESC,m.id LIMIT 20001
memories: SELECT m.id,m.created_at AS createdAt,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM local_photos p WHERE p.user_id=m.user_id AND p.memory_id=m.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS photos FROM local_memories m WHERE m.user_id=? AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND julianday(m.created_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(m.created_at)<=julianday(?) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id LIMIT 20001
memoryJourneys: SELECT DISTINCT m.id AS memoryId,j.id AS journeyId FROM local_memories m JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(m.collection_ids) THEN m.collection_ids ELSE '[]' END) links JOIN local_journeys j ON j.id=links.value AND j.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.user_id=? AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND julianday(j.started_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(j.ended_at)<=julianday(?) LIMIT 20001
markers: SELECT m.id,j.id AS journeyId,m.captured_at AS capturedAt,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM local_marker_media media WHERE media.marker_id=m.id AND media.kind='photo' AND media.deleted_at IS NULL) AS photos FROM local_journey_markers m JOIN local_journeys j ON j.user_id=m.user_id LEFT JOIN local_journey_edit_members e ON e.journey_id=j.id AND e.user_id=j.user_id WHERE m.user_id=? AND julianday(j.started_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(j.ended_at)<=julianday(?) AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.root_journey_id=COALESCE(e.root_id,j.id) AND m.captured_at>=j.started_at AND m.captured_at<=j.ended_at AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_journeys next JOIN local_journey_edit_members n ON n.journey_id=next.id WHERE n.user_id=m.user_id AND n.root_id=m.root_journey_id AND n.active=1 AND next.started_at=m.captured_at AND next.started_at>j.started_at) ORDER BY m.captured_at DESC,m.id LIMIT 20001
places: SELECT id,kind,CASE WHEN kind='geocoded' THEN label ELSE '' END AS label FROM local_places WHERE user_id=? LIMIT 20001
